svg.text: Decision curves with declared reference strategies
Same synthetic evaluation cohort; G1/G7=model, G3=treat all, G4=treat none; No uncertainty supplied: bounds equal the
frozen curves; opt-in decision convention; frozen summaries, no smoothing.
